findings.title: Q3 authority alignment values do not reproduce from the committed derivation
evidence: P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md:47-48 and Q0_RESOLVED.md:16 quote VBM-referenced +75.9 meV and semicore-aligned +52.1 meV, and each document's provenance banner says derive_q3.py recomputes every quoted value.

derive_q3.py:189-196 instead computes and prints VBM-referenced -75.8 meV and semicore-referenced -33.5 meV from the committed raw outputs. Reversing subtraction direction could account for the VBM sign but cannot reconcile 52.1 with 33.5 meV.

proposed_check: C-Q3-NUM-001 — run derive_q3.py, parse its normalized VBM and semicore alignment outputs, and require every Q3 authority table/summary to match the same declared subtraction convention and values; a fixture retaining +52.1 meV when the derivation emits -33.5 meV must fail.

findings.title: Canonical Q3 index asserts mutually incompatible raw-provenance states
evidence: RESULTS_INDEX.md:36-46 currently asserts that Q3 raw inputs are not committed and quoted values cannot be reproduced from committed records; its lines 51-55 assert the same raw records are COMMITTED and derive_q3.py exits 0.

The index-named authority documents Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md:1-8, Q0_RESOLVED.md:1-8, and P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md:1-8 likewise assert that the raw records are now committed. The absent-raw assertion is unmarked and current.

reproduce: sed -n '34,58p' RESULTS_INDEX.md; for f in results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_RESOLVED.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md; do sed -n '1,8p' "$f"; done

proposed_check: C-Q3-STATUS-001 — parse each canonical Q3 index row and its discovered authorities; when the row names committed q3_raw evidence and derive_q3.py exits 0, reject any unmarked assertion in that row or authority that raw inputs are not committed or cannot be reproduced. The present Q3 row is the failing fixture.

verified_closed_findings.verification_summary: In an isolated clean clone at the audited commit, the committed Q3 raw outputs, custody record, 160-to-159 mapping artifact, and derive_q3.py were present; the derivation exited 0 after recomputing the recorded Q3 evidence chain.

The three Q3 authority documents discovered from RESULTS_INDEX.md each carry the required Q3 provenance/demotion banner, and clean-clone regression group 37 exercised the index-discovered authority sweep successfully.

Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md marks the former plateau statement SUPERSEDED, while q0_final_ns1.out.gz contains the formal QE convergence block and the current gate/index state agrees that both q=0 endpoints converged.

summary: BLOCK: independently recomputable Q3 raw evidence is now present, but its alignment values conflict with the authority documents and the canonical index retains contradictory raw-provenance assertions.

coverage.method: Read the canonical index and Objective 1 authorities in prescribed order, then traced Q3 claims through committed raw outputs, custody records, the mapping record, derivation code, raw QE convergence output, and a clean-clone test execution.
not_examined: Objective 2 and XRD raw datasets were not independently recomputed this re-audit; their current Tier-0 checks were reviewed only.
No remote cluster, scheduler, or instrument state was accessed.
